images.caption:
This was one of the few actual railway stations the Rocky Mountaineer goes through.  Mission is a city that's the outer limit of the West Coast Express which provides commuter trains to Vancouver, taking about 80 minutes to get there.

Or for a slower journey, you can take the West Coast Express TrainBus!  Which is a bus.  That follows the train line.
